title: Sliding window of recent events
hints: deque(maxlen=n) throws away the leftmost item by itself when you append to a full deque; you never write the eviction code.
Counter(self._events) counts whatever is currently in the deque; dict(...) turns it into a plain dict without zero entries.
sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0])) orders by count descending and kind ascending in one key.
is_alerting is a single boolean expression: len(self) == self.maxlen and self.ratio(kind) >= threshold.
